articles.title: UTEP AIAA Students Explore WSMR’s Historic Sites and Career Opportunities
articles.summary: On Nov. 6, UTEP’s American Institute of Aeronautics and Astronautics or AIAA students visited White Sands Missile Range.

articles.title: Mount Morris Dam expands public engagement during 2026 visitor season
articles.summary: New York — The Mount Morris Dam and Recreation Area expanded public engagement during its 2026 visitor season, increasing participation in ranger-led dam tours, special events, educational programs and volunteer service while continuing to deliver flood risk management and environmental stewardship for the Genesee River Valley.

articles.title: ACC-RSA Acting Executive Director Jeffrey Caldwell selected for Senior Executive Service
articles.summary: ACC-RSA Acting Executive Director Jeffrey L. Caldwell has been selected for the Senior Executive Service and appointed executive director of U.S. Army Contracting Command-Redstone Arsenal, effective Dec. 13, 2026.

articles.title: Neros to expand domestic drone production with $450M Pentagon loan
articles.summary: The company is a frontrunner in a Defense Department competition to find the best quality, most affordable small drone for combat.

articles.title: Gen. Brunson Thanks Japan's Defense Minister for Support to UNC-Rear
articles.summary: TOKYO, Japan - Gen. Xavier T. Brunson, commander of United Nations Command, Combined Forces Command and U.S. Forces Korea, met with Japanese Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi at the Ministry of Defense in Tokyo on Nov. 5 to thank Japan for its continued support to UNC-Rear and to reaffirm the U.S.-Japan Alliance.

articles.title: Fort McCoy advances 2026–2030 strategic plan as new fiscal year begins
articles.summary: As fiscal year 2027 moves forward, U.S. Army Garrison-Fort McCoy is continuing to implement a long-range strategic plan designed to guide installation operations, strengthen military readiness, modernize infrastructure, and prepare the installation for the Army's evolving requirements through 2030.

articles.title: 5th Air Force hosts JAAGA, strengthening U.S.-Japan bilateral operations at Yokota
articles.summary: 5th Air Force hosted 36 members of the Japan-America Air Force Goodwill Association, or JAAGA, during a visit to Yokota Air Base Nov. 5, 2026, reinforcing the longstanding relationship among U.S. Air Force personnel, Japan Air Self-Defense Force members and Japanese community leaders.

articles.title: 403rd Army Field Support Brigade Personality Spotlight: Ms. Pak, Hye Yong – LRC-North
articles.summary: Ms. Pak, Hye Yong began her career with the U.S. Army in February 2014 at LRC-North. She started as a Supply Technician and has served as the Quartermaster Laundry (QML) Manager at Yongsan since April 2022. In her current role, she oversees overall QML operations, staff management, and budget execution.

articles.title: Red, Blue & Camo: One State, Two Teams, One Guard
articles.summary: The Utah National Guard supported the University of Utah-BYU football rivalry game Nov. 7, 2026, at Rice-Eccles Stadium through a series of military appreciation activities that brought together service members, fans and students from both schools.

articles.title: Georgia Guardsmen battle in combined-MSC competition
articles.summary: Eight Georgia Army National Guard Soldiers competed in the Fiscal Year 2027 Combined Best Warrior Competition Nov. 6–8, 2026, at Fort Stewart, Georgia. The 78th Troop Command named U.S. Army Sgt. 1st Class Jeremy Nicoli its Noncommissioned Officer of the Year and U.S. Army Spc. Clinet Reier its Soldier of the Year.

articles.title: ROK-U.S. Combined Forces Command Marks 48 Years of Combined Defense
articles.summary: CFC commemorates 48 years of strengthening the ROK-U.S. alliance and maintaining readiness on the Korean Peninsula

articles.title: Tennessee Guard Soldier's promotion reunites former public affairs team
articles.summary: Tennessee Army National Guard Master Sgt. Lila A. Walker, a former public affairs specialist with the 118th Mobile Public Affairs Detachment, was promoted during a ceremony at Joint Force Headquarters in Nashville, Tennessee, Nov. 8, 2026.

articles.title: 73 APS welcomes new commander
articles.summary: U.S. Air Force Maj. Charles Smith assumed command of the 73rd Aerial Port Squadron during a ceremony here Nov. 7, 2026.
